title: Moemedi wa Morwalela o Mogolo
intro: Motho yono o ne a ema jaaka pilara ya boitshoko ka makgolokgolo a dingwaga, a bitsa setšhaba se se neng se sa ikobele go ya kwa leseding la boammaaruri fa se ntse se lebane le go sotlwa le go ganwa. Le fa go ne go na le mathata a magolo le bokete jwa molaetsa o o neng o akaretsa dikokomana, motlhanka yono o ne a nna a nitame mo thomong ya bone go fitlha go ntshiwa taelo ya bofelo.
clues: Ke feditse dingwaga di le makgolo a le robongwe le masome a matlhano ke bitsa batho ba me mo tseleng ya tshiamo, motshegare le bosigo, mo sephiring le mo phatlalatseng.
Ke tlhagisitse batho ba me ka kotlhao e e botlhoko, le fa go ntse jalo ba ne ba tsenya menwana mo ditsebeng tsa bone mme ba ipipa ka diaparo tsa bone ka boikgogomoso.
Ke ne ka laelwa go aga sengwe se segolo ka fa tlase ga matlho a a tlhokometseng a Morena wa me, le fa go ne go se na metsi a a bonalang.
Fa ke ntse ke bereka, baeteledipele ba batho ba gaetsho ba ne ba feta ba ntshotla, mme ke ne ka ba bolelela gore go ise go ye kae, e tla bo e le rona re ba sotlang.
Ke ne ka kopa nama le madi a me gore di nne le nna, mme ba ne ba tlhopha go batla botshabelo mo thabeng, ba dumela gore e tla ba boloka mo lekhubung le le neng le tlhatloga.
Sejana sa me se ne sa feleletsa se eme mo Thabeng ya Judi morago ga gore lefatshe le kometse metsi a lone le loapi lo kgaotse go na.

outcome.label: Botso
options: Go Tsena mo Lefatsheng le le Solofeditsweng
Go nwela mo Lewatleng le Lehibidu
Go ikhutsa mo Thabeng ya Judi
outcome.answer: Go ikhutsa mo Thabeng ya Judi

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
